title: From Bytes to Borsch: Fine-Tuning Gemma and Mistral for the Ukrainian Language Representation

bias_targets.methodology: Benchmarking generative language models on their proficiency in a low-resource language (Ukrainian) using the Ukrainian External Independent Testing (EIT) multiple-choice questions, and manually evaluating open-ended prompts for language consistency, grammar, factual correctness, and relevance.

Evaluating the models' conceptual understanding and factual accuracy regarding Ukrainian history, literature, and culturally specific concepts (e.g., traditional dishes like 'borsch') using national exam datasets and a custom Ukrainian Knowledge and Instruction Dataset (UKID), while also analyzing qualitative artifacts like code-switching ('Azirivka').
